description: Send a bug report, feature request, documentation gap or limitation about AILANG to the AILANG team. Use it only when the user asks to report something, and leave out personal or confidential information. Categories: bug, feature, docs, limitation. Body up to 10 KB, snippet up to 4 KB. `contact` is optional, for a reply. `package` (vendor/name) sends the report to that AILANG package's maintainers instead. Returns a ticket ID.

ailang_version.description: The reporter's CLI version (free-form, used for triage)

auto_dispatch.description: Let the package maintainers' automation act on the report before a person reads it. Only if the user asks. Default false: a person triages it first.

contact.description: Optional address for a reply. Only if the user gives one

package.description: Optional vendor/name (e.g. "sunholo/auth") to send the report to that package's maintainers. Empty = the AILANG team.

name: submit_feedback
title: Send feedback
